evidence.finding: The released vibe-kanban npm command registers three subcommands: the default launches the local app (browser, or desktop with --desktop), review runs a PR review CLI, and mcp runs the local MCP server.

evidence.title: Vibe Kanban backend analytics gate
evidence.locator: crates/deployment/src/lib.rs lines 141-146 (track_if_analytics_allowed), commit 4deb7ec
evidence.finding: Backend event tracking only fires when the config flag analytics_enabled is true and an analytics client is configured; turning the flag off stops backend tracking.

evidence.title: Vibe Kanban web analytics opt-out
evidence.locator: packages/local-web/src/routes/__root.tsx lines 15-30 (root route PostHog effect), commit 4deb7ec
evidence.finding: The local web UI opts PostHog capture in when analytics_enabled is true and calls opt_out_capturing when it is false.

evidence.title: Vibe Kanban login re-enables analytics
evidence.locator: crates/server/src/routes/oauth.rs lines 349-354 (OAuth callback config update), commit 4deb7ec
evidence.finding: After a successful Vibe Kanban sign-in, the server sets analytics_enabled back to true if it was off and saves the config, so the opt-out does not survive a login.

evidence.title: Vibe Kanban telemetry setting
evidence.locator: docs/settings/general.mdx lines 173-175 (Telemetry section), commit 4deb7ec
evidence.finding: General settings documentation describes a control to enable or disable telemetry collection.

evidence.title: Vibe Kanban local API and trigger inspection
evidence.locator: Local router and session routes; bounded search of crates/server, crates/services and crates/mcp for cron, schedule, webhook and trigger
evidence.finding: The surviving local API starts workspace/session work from explicit requests. No local schedule or external-event work starter is registered. Webhook PR reviews exist in the separate retired remote service, not the local continuation.

evidence.title: Released Vibe Kanban orchestrator MCP mode
evidence.locator: --mode orchestrator launch; task_server tools/handler; crates/db/src/models/workspace.rs load_context; npx-cli/src/cli.ts mcp forwarding
evidence.finding: The released CLI accepts --mcp --mode orchestrator. That mode designates the first workspace session as orchestrator, scopes its tools to the workspace and offers create_session, run_session_prompt, list_sessions and get_execution with final results. It is an explicitly shipped coordinator role, separate from the earlier unreleased orchestrator UI experiment.

evidence.title: Vibe Kanban local execution ownership
evidence.locator: LocalContainerService workspace_to_current_dir and start_execution lines 1197 and 1320-1399; crates/server/src/main.rs shutdown_signal
evidence.finding: The local service starts coding-agent executors directly in workspace directories and retains their child processes and exit monitors in the backend. Despite its name, LocalContainerService provides no Docker/container or VM backend. Server shutdown follows process signals, not browser disconnection. With the documented user-server deployment, work continues independently of the controlling laptop.

evidence.title: Vibe Kanban complete native client distribution matrix
evidence.locator: build-binaries matrix; build-tauri matrix lines 702-730; complete installer collection lines 986-1000 and 1123 onward
evidence.finding: The pinned release workflow builds native server/CLI and Tauri client targets for macOS, Windows and Linux, and publishes desktop DMG, AppImage, DEB, MSI and EXE installers. Its complete native build and installer inventory has no iOS or Android phone package. Browser clients are separate.

RUN-01.answer: Local agent execution continues. BYO hosting is documented, but laptop-independent operation and current vendor remote access were not tested.

SHIP-02.answer: Repository scripts can run checks; docs advise review and CI before merge. Required/enforced checks and spec gates were not established.
